id: 04_Minimizing Risks in the Chemistry Laboratory ACS College Safety Video 4
title: 降低化学实验室的风险
source_doc: course/ACS College Lab Safety Series/04_Minimizing Risks in the Chemistry Laboratory ACS College Safety Video 4.md
author_source: project/ACS College Lab Safety Series/04_Minimizing Risks in the Chemistry Laboratory ACS College Safety Video 4/src.py

points.K1: 防护装备按风险评估来选
points.K3: 先想：化学品怎么进入人体
points.K13: 管理控制：守规则、读注意事项
points.K16: 手套：选对材质、一次性用
points.K17: 手套上的化学品会“搬家”

shots.scene: 欣欣穿实验服戴护目镜手套，站在通风橱旁向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves stands beside a chemical fume hood and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学实验室怎样降低风险。
overlay: 降低化学实验室的风险

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon with five colored layers, each marked by a simple icon. No people.
shots.narration: 堵住途径，按层级选措施。

shots.scene: 阿杰短袖、没戴护目镜，正要走向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a short-sleeved shirt and no goggles walks toward a lab bench with a beaker.
shots.narration: 阿杰穿着短袖，护目镜也没戴。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着门口的防护用品架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a rack of lab coats and goggles by the lab door.
shots.narration: 小研说：风险能降，可你一样没做。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 降低风险，有方法，也有顺序。

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套，站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand at a lab bench wearing lab coats, safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 片中的防护装备，是按风险评估选的。
overlay: 防护装备按风险评估来选

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 欣欣不穿实验服，站在没有试剂瓶的讲解台后
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot without a lab coat stands behind a clean demonstration bench with no reagent bottles on it.
shots.narration: 主持人不戴防护时，化学品都已撤走。

shots.scene: 四个图标，第三个向下箭头亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row; the third one, a down arrow over a warning triangle, lights up brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 降低风险，是四步中的第三步。

shots.scene: 前两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The first two icons, a magnifying glass and a balance scale, get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课假定危害已识别、风险已评估。

shots.section_title: 先想：化学品怎么进入人体
shots.scene: 人体轮廓上四个箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with four arrows pointing in at the nose, eyes, skin and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步：想清楚化学品怎么进入人体。
overlay: 先想：化学品怎么进入人体

shots.section_title: 先想：化学品怎么进入人体
shots.scene: 欣欣数手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its paw, holding up four fingers.
shots.narration: 一共有四条途径。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标旁飘着气体
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon with faint gas wisps drifting into it from a gas cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入，是最常见的途径。

shots.scene: 气瓶、冒蒸气的烧杯、冒烟的粉末三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a gas cylinder, a beaker with rising vapor, and a dish of powder giving off fumes. No people.
shots.narration: 气体、液体蒸气、固体烟雾都能吸入。

shots.scene: 闻到气味的鼻子图标，旁边打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon sniffing a wisp of vapor, with a red X beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 闻到气味，就说明你已经吸进去了。

shots.scene: 看不见的气体图标，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: Nearly invisible gas swirls around a nose icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有的气体无味或太稀，闻不到也有害。

shots.scene: 手和眼睛两个图标，液滴溅来
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hand and an eye, with small liquid droplets splashing toward them. No people.
shots.narration: 第二常见的，是皮肤和眼睛接触。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标被单独圈出
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon circled in red, separated from the hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛极其娇嫩，要单独当一条途径。

shots.scene: 碎玻璃图标和一滴液体
shots.prompt_en: An icon of broken glassware with a drop of liquid on a sharp edge and a small cut finger icon. No people.
shots.narration: 被沾有化学品的碎玻璃割伤，就是注入。

shots.scene: 食物、饮料、尝味的图标都打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sandwich, a drink cup and a tongue tasting a spoon, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室严禁品尝化学品，严禁饮食。

shots.scene: 欣欣认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods seriously.
shots.narration: 这样，食入就很少发生了。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔，从上到下五层
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon with five colored layers from blue at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 降低风险，可以按控制层级来想。

shots.scene: 顶层亮起，向下逐渐变暗
shots.prompt_en: The top layer of the inverted pyramid glows brightly while lower layers fade. No people.
shots.narration: 越往上越有效，越往下越不可靠。

shots.scene: 危害图标被整个拿走，风险表归零
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon is lifted away and disappears, and a gauge meter drops to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 最好是消除：没有危害就没有风险。

shots.scene: 大烧瓶缩小成小试管
shots.prompt_en: A large flask icon shrinking into a small test tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 消除不了，就缩小实验规模。

shots.scene: 小规模出错影响小，旁边一枚硬币
shots.prompt_en: A small spill icon with a small splash, next to a coin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 万一出错影响小，还更省钱。

shots.scene: 带火焰象形图的瓶子换成绿叶图标瓶子
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a flame pictogram slides away and is replaced by a bottle with a green leaf icon. No people.
shots.narration: 替代：易燃溶剂换成不太易燃的。

shots.scene: 替代后风险表下降
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter needle moving down after the swap. No people.
shots.narration: 效果和消除差不多。

shots.scene: 前两层旁出现设计图纸图标
shots.prompt_en: A blueprint icon appears beside the top two layers of the inverted pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 消除和替代，属于实验设计。

shots.scene: 老周在空白讲义上修改步骤
shots.prompt_en: The older man edits a blank lab manual at his desk, crossing out one bottle icon and drawing another.
shots.narration: 老师设计实验时，通常已经考虑过。

shots.scene: 下三层依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The bottom three layers of the inverted pyramid light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 在实验室里，你能做的是下面三层。

shots.scene: 风险表随可能性下降而下降
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon shrinking and a gauge meter needle dropping with it. No people.
shots.narration: 降低暴露的可能，就是降低风险。

shots.scene: 通风橱图标，气体被向上抽走
shots.prompt_en: A chemical fume hood with gray vapor being drawn up and away through the duct. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制，在实验室通常就是通风橱。

shots.scene: 鼻子、火焰、爆炸三个图标被打勾防住
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a nose, a flame and a burst, each covered by a small shield. No people.
shots.narration: 排走气体蒸气，减少吸入和着火爆炸。

shots.scene: 错误使用通风橱、人却很放心的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person relaxing in front of a fume hood with the sash fully open and clutter inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用错了，只会带来虚假的安全感。

shots.scene: 小研在橱口拿一张纸巾，纸巾被吸向里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves holds a tissue at the face of the fume hood; the tissue bends inward.
shots.narration: 先在橱口拿张纸巾，看看在不在抽风。

shots.scene: 通风橱侧面的空白检测标签打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection sticker on the side of a fume hood with a green check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再看检测标签，确认有人定期维护。

shots.scene: 小研把加热板往通风橱里侧推
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pushes a hot plate deeper inside the fume hood, away from the sash.
shots.narration: 设备往里放，离拉门至少六英寸。

shots.scene: 橱内堆满瓶子的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crowded with bottles and boxes blocking the back, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 多余的瓶子和设备拿走，别挡气流。

shots.scene: 橱内易燃试剂瓶被移出
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes a bottle with a flame pictogram from the fume hood and places it into a cabinet.
shots.narration: 不在通风橱里存放易燃化学品。

shots.scene: 小研把拉门拉低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the fume hood sash down low.
shots.narration: 操作时，把拉门拉低。

shots.scene: 拉门全关的通风橱里一个小火苗被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with the sash fully closed, a small flame icon contained behind the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 万一着火，关好拉门能减轻影响。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：守规则、读注意事项
shots.scene: 倒金字塔第四层亮起，旁边一本空白规则手册
shots.prompt_en: The fourth layer of the inverted pyramid lights up beside a blank rule handbook. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制，是一整套安全行为。
overlay: 管理控制：守规则、读注意事项

shots.section_title: 管理控制：守规则、读注意事项
shots.scene: 实验室墙上的空白守则牌，阿杰在看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank rules board on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 学校的实验室守则，都是为降风险定的。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：守规则、读注意事项
shots.scene: 小研在实验前阅读讲义上的安全提示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the safety notes section of a blank lab manual before the lab, a warning triangle icon on the page.
shots.narration: 实验前，先读安全注意事项。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：守规则、读注意事项
shots.scene: 讲义步骤逐条打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure list with steps getting green checks in order. No people.
shots.narration: 按写好的步骤做，不随意跳步。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔最底层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer of the inverted pyramid lights up red. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护和着装，是最后一道防线。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上防溅护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a pair of indirectly vented splash goggles.
shots.narration: 可能有飞溅，就必须护好眼睛。

shots.scene: 防溅护目镜和安全眼镜并排
shots.prompt_en: Splash goggles and safety glasses side by side, the goggles marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 多数情况，戴间接通风的防溅护目镜。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着门口的空白规定牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank rules sign beside the lab door with a goggles icon.
shots.narration: 具体戴哪种，按本校规定。

shots.scene: 小研穿长袖衣服，旁边短袖图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a long-sleeved shirt; a small short-sleeve shirt icon beside her is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 着装要尽量遮住皮肤，长袖比短袖好。

shots.scene: 棉花图标打勾，化纤图标旁边火焰
shots.prompt_en: A cotton boll icon with a green check next to a synthetic fabric icon with a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 天然纤维最好，化纤更容易燃烧。

shots.scene: 小研穿上实验服扣好扣子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat and buttons it all the way up.
shots.narration: 按规定穿实验服，扣好扣子。

shots.section_title: 手套：选对材质、一次性用
shots.scene: 阿杰戴上手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat and goggles pulls on disposable gloves.
shots.narration: 防皮肤接触，手套最管用。
overlay: 手套：选对材质、一次性用

shots.section_title: 手套：选对材质、一次性用
shots.scene: 一次性手套图标旁边循环箭头打叉
shots.prompt_en: A disposable glove icon with a recycle arrow crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验手套是一次性的，不重复用。

shots.section_title: 手套：选对材质、一次性用
shots.scene: 三种手套和一瓶试剂，连线选中一种
shots.prompt_en: Three different glove icons with a line connecting one of them to a reagent bottle, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 按所用化学品，选耐受的材质。

shots.section_title: 手套：选对材质、一次性用
shots.scene: 电脑上空白的手套耐受性表
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a blank compatibility chart with glove icons and check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 可以查手套耐化学品性能的资料。

shots.section_title: 手套：选对材质、一次性用
shots.scene: 老周给学生分发选好的手套
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands out a box of selected gloves to students.
shots.narration: 实验课上，听老师的手套规定。

shots.section_title: 手套上的化学品会“搬家”
shots.scene: 紫外灯下手套上发光的痕迹
shots.prompt_en: Under a dark ultraviolet light, a gloved hand shows glowing spots of dye. No people.
shots.narration: 手套上沾的化学品，会到处“搬家”。
overlay: 手套上的化学品会“搬家”

shots.section_title: 手套上的化学品会“搬家”
shots.scene: 计算器、电脑、手机上都出现发光痕迹
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dye spots appear on a calculator, a computer keyboard and a mobile phone. No people.
shots.narration: 计算器、电脑、手机，都会被沾上。

shots.section_title: 手套上的化学品会“搬家”
shots.scene: 笔上发光，再靠近嘴的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A glowing pen moving toward a mouth icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 笔放进嘴里，化学品就进了身体。

shots.section_title: 手套上的化学品会“搬家”
shots.scene: 食物饮料带进实验室的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a coffee cup and a snack in a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 所以实验室里不能饮食。

shots.scene: 小研在实验室门口脱手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves before reaching the lab door.
shots.narration: 离开实验室前，一定先脱手套。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽用洗手液洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands with soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 实验结束，认真洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣不穿实验服，戴着手套，捏住一只手套的手腕处
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot without a lab coat, wearing disposable gloves, pinches one glove near the wrist with the other gloved paw.
shots.narration: 捏住手套靠近手腕的地方，

shots.scene: 边剥边翻转
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the glove being peeled off and turned inside out. No people.
shots.narration: 边往下剥，边把它翻过来。

shots.scene: 脱下的手套团在仍戴手套的手心
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the removed glove crumpled in the palm of the still-gloved hand. No people.
shots.narration: 把脱下的这只，团在手心。

shots.scene: 裸手手指从手套内侧伸入剥下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a bare finger sliding inside the cuff of the second glove and peeling it off. No people.
shots.narration: 裸手从内侧伸进第二只，往下剥。

shots.scene: 第二只把第一只包在里面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the second glove turned inside out, enclosing the first one in a neat bundle. No people.
shots.narration: 把第一只包在里面，外面不碰皮肤。

shots.scene: 手套团丢进指定的收集桶
shots.prompt_en: The bundled gloves dropped into a designated waste bin with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 按老师的要求丢弃。

shots.scene: 风险表停在低区，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter with the needle in the green low zone and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 多大的风险可以接受？

shots.scene: 老周在讲义上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The older man ticks items on a blank lab manual with a pen.
shots.narration: 教学实验，老师已把风险降得较低。

shots.scene: 风险表指针在黄区，旁边一个找不到替代品的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter with the needle in the yellow middle zone beside a bottle with a warning pictogram and a crossed-out swap arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 高危又无替代品时，风险可能是中等。

shots.scene: 小研在科研实验室思考
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands thoughtfully in a research lab next to complex glassware.
shots.narration: 科研中何时接受更高风险，更复杂。

shots.scene: 欣欣眼睛发亮，像雷达一样环顾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks around the lab alertly with a radar ring icon above its head.
shots.narration: 安全，要求时刻保持警惕。

shots.scene: 人体途径、通风橱、护目镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a body outline with arrows, a fume hood, and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 想清途径，用好通风橱，穿对防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁人体四条途径图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a body outline with four arrows.
shots.narration: 先想清四条暴露途径。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔从上到下点亮
shots.prompt_en: The inverted pyramid lights up layer by layer from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 消除替代优先，再工程、管理、防护。

shots.scene: 纸巾、标签、拉门三个通风橱图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a tissue at a hood, an inspection sticker, and a lowered sash. No people.
shots.narration: 通风橱查风、查标签、拉低拉门。

shots.scene: 护目镜、长袖实验服、手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of splash goggles, a long-sleeved lab coat and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜、实验服、手套，一样不少。

shots.scene: 脱手套和洗手图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves being turned inside out and hands being washed. No people.
shots.narration: 正确脱手套，离开前洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣摘下手套，洗完手向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot with clean paws waves goodbye at the camera beside a lab sink.
shots.narration: 层层设防，安全实验，谢谢观看！
